Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment
Substitute Narrative and Plans

1726 W Cullerton St
From RT to RM-4.5

1.A. The applicant seeks a zoning change from RT-4 to RM-4.5 to meet the bulk and
density standards of the RM-4.5 zoning district to bring the existing property into
compliance and allow for the construction of a new detached 2-car garage with a

toof deck.

FAR 1.204
Density (MLA) 3
Building Area 3,614.13 SF
Lot Area 3,000 SF
Building Height 36’ 3”
Front Setback 14’ 6.5”
Rear Setback * 0’
East Side Setback** 0’
West Side Setback ** 0
Parking*** 2

* Per Section 17-13-1101-B applicant seeks a variance to reduce the required rear

yard setback from 37’ 6” to 0’.
rt Per Section 17-13-1101-B applicant seeks a variance to reduce the minimum
required west side yard setback from 2’ to 0’; and to reduce the minimum east
side yard setback from 3’-3/8” to 0’ for a combined side yard setback of 0’.

*** Per Section 17-13-1101-D applicant seeks a variance to reduce the amount of
required parking from 3 spaces to 2 spaces.
